title: acmella garcinii
intro: Acmella garcinii, commonly known as Szechuan pepper flower, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the alleviation of inflammation, reduction of pain, and improvement of digestion. The therapeutic actions of Acmella garcinii include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and sesquiterpene esters, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
